diagnosisRequirements.description: Active rheumatoid arthritis with evidence of moderate to severe disease activity
diagnosisRequirements.evidenceText: Member has active rheumatoid arthritis with documented evidence of moderate to severe disease activity, including elevated inflammatory markers (ESR or CRP) or active joint involvement.

source.document: Aetna Clinical Policy Bulletin 0726 - Biologic Response Modifiers

stepTherapy.failureCriteria: inadequate response despite therapeutic dosing, or documented contraindication or intolerance
stepTherapy.evidenceText: Member has had an inadequate response to a trial of at least 3 months of methotrexate at a dose of at least 15 mg weekly (unless contraindicated or not tolerated). Inadequate response is defined as persistent moderate to severe disease activity.

source.document: Aetna Clinical Policy Bulletin 0726 - Biologic Response Modifiers

otherRequirements.evidenceText: The medication is prescribed by a physician who specializes in rheumatology.

source.document: Aetna Clinical Policy Bulletin 0726 - Biologic Response Modifiers

otherRequirements.requirement: Tuberculosis screening required prior to initiation
otherRequirements.evidenceText: Member has been screened for tuberculosis infection prior to initiating therapy, and active tuberculosis has been ruled out or treated appropriately if present.

source.document: Aetna Clinical Policy Bulletin 0726 - Biologic Response Modifiers

otherRequirements.requirement: Baseline laboratory tests within 3 months of initiation
otherRequirements.evidenceText: Member has had baseline laboratory evaluation including CBC, hepatic function panel, and assessment for hepatitis B within 3 months prior to therapy initiation.

source.document: Aetna Clinical Policy Bulletin 0726 - Biologic Response Modifiers

otherRequirements.requirement: Dosing must be consistent with FDA-approved labeling
otherRequirements.evidenceText: The requested dose and frequency are consistent with FDA-approved labeling or evidence-based practice guidelines. Quantity limits may apply per fill and per plan year.

source.document: Aetna Clinical Policy Bulletin 0726 - Biologic Response Modifiers
